bias.en: Downtrend · rebound failed at $400, back under $384
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 反弹受阻 $400，回落至 $384 下方

read.en: Rockwell Automation fell 3.2% on Nov 19 to $383.10, trading $382.40–400.62, its lowest close since Nov 6. It is below the 5-day ($391.5), 10-day ($393.0), 30-day ($418.5), 200-day ($425.8) and 100-day ($437.0), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, below zero, histogram widening slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($427.41), and RSI is 37.7.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 11月19日下跌 3.2%，收于 $383.10，盘中区间 $382.40–400.62，为 11月6日以来最低收盘。股价位于 5 日（$391.5）、10 日（$393.0）、30 日（$418.5）、200 日（$425.8）和 100 日均线（$437.0）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图略有放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$427.41），RSI 为 37.7。

read.en: The $400.62 high stalled under $401.7 again, and the close gave up the 5 and 10-day averages and broke the $394, $389.5 and $384 supports, now resistance. Resistance is $383.1–384.9, then $388.4–391.5 (5-day) and $393–395.9 (10-day, Nov 18 close). Support is $375.9–378.3 (Nov 6 close, Nov 5 low), then $370.7 (Nov 6 low) and $360. A close above $384.9 would target $388–391; below $375.9, $370.7.

r.en: Nov 9 low $383.13; Nov 16 low $383.72; Nov 16 close $384.90, lost
